item.title: Dolly Parton Day celebrated nationwide across America
item.description: Sept. 25, or 9/25, references Dolly's hit "9 to 5." David Muir reports on how Americans are marking the occasion.

item.title: Iran live updates: Trump rejects offer to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday morning that he rejected Iran's seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Four American tourists killed in Greece building explosion
item.description: The mayor of Athens said the explosion was likely caused by a gas leak.

item.title: Annual Fat Bear Week tournament gets underway
item.description: Mike Fitz, resident naturalist for Explore.org, explains the competition where people vote for the fattest bear of the year.
